OpenLP.note: Another worship app we import from

service.note: The ordered list of songs and Bible passages for one meeting, saved as a file. Not the meeting itself.

go live.note: Put an item or slide on the projector

live.note: What is on the projector right now. Inside "go live" it's proyectar.

cue.note: Select the next service item so it goes live next

slide.note: A noun: one screen of text. The transition "Slide up" is a verb: deslizar.

theme.note: How slides look on the projector: font, colors, background

verse.note: Of a song: estrofa. Of the Bible: versículo.

reference.note: A Bible reference such as Jn 3:16

settings.note: As in Apple's Spanish (Latin America): Configuración

remote.note: The web page that controls Asaf from a phone

outline.note: The stroke around the slide text

operator.note: The person running Asaf during the meeting
